faq_heading: Homes near Latimer Road Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Latimer Road Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Latimer Road Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Latimer Road Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Latimer Road Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 95 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,222,500, townhomes $596,000, condos $445,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Latimer Road Elementary?
faq.a: For the 95 homes that sold within 1 km of Latimer Road Elementary, the median time on the market was 23 days and the median sale was 96.9% of list; 4% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Latimer Road Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Sunrise Ridge Elementary (1.0 km west), Crescent Heights Academy (1.1 km north-east) and Bibleway Christian Academy (1.1 km west).

How the Latimer Road Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Latimer Road Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Latimer Road Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 95 homes sold within 1 km of Latimer Road Elementary: 46 houses, 26 townhomes and 23 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,222,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Latimer Road Elementary

17 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Latimer Road Elementary in a straight line (12 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other; 3 independent). The closest is Sunrise Ridge Elementary, 1.0 km away, and the farthest on this list is R C Garnett Demonstration Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Clayton Heights Secondary (2.2 km); the nearest independent school is Crescent Heights Academy (1.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Sunrise Ridge Elementary (1.0 km west), Hillcrest Elementary (1.7 km north-west), Langley Meadows Elementary (1.7 km north-east), Don Christian Elementary (1.7 km west), Martha Currie Elementary (1.7 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Sunrise Ridge Elementary, 1.0 km west of Latimer Road Elementary.
